issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Animal.messageOnFeed(): The problem statement (UML and Task 1) specifies an abstract method messageOnFeed() that returns a String and subsequent tasks/instructions expect printed String values from messageOnFeed(). The solution repository defines Animal.messageOnFeed() with return type FeedResponse (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java line 18) and all concrete animals return FeedResponse objects. This difference will confuse students: the exercise text and UML ask them to implement/print String messages, but the solution code uses a custom FeedResponse type, producing an inconsistent API and potential compilation/test failures if students follow the problem statement.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one consistent API and apply it across problem statement and solution. Preferred student-friendly fix: change the solution to match the problem statement by making Animal.messageOnFeed() return String and update all concrete implementations (Seal, Pig, Goat) to return the String messages (e.g., "Arf Arf!", "Oink!", "Maah!") and remove or adapt FeedResponse usage. Alternative: if FeedResponse is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to specify messageOnFeed(): FeedResponse and document how to extract/print the message (e.g., call toString() or getMessage()), so students are not required to implement a different return type than provided in the reference.
